items.scene: Xiao Ming receives a bicycle on his birthday.
items.question: What is Xiao Ming's emotion?
items.why_this_case_matters: From ToMBench Unexpected Outcome Test (Emotion: Typical emotional reactions; story 'Xiao Ming receives a bicycle on his birthday'). Real item, gold preserved. The answer is the default reaction to a normal positive event, decided by typicality with no twist and no observed sample, which is exactly this unit.

items.scene: SYNTHETIC. At a conference, 90 attendees are engineers and 10 are poets. Jordan is described as quiet, precise, and always carrying a notebook.
items.question: Who is Jordan more likely to be?
items.why_this_case_matters: SYNTHETIC (classic base-rate vignette; no dedicated base-rate task exists in ToMBench). The notebook description is representative, not diagnostic, so the strong 90-to-10 base rate makes engineer more likely. Tests resisting base-rate neglect.

items.scene: SYNTHETIC. A clinic usually expects flu and cold cases to be about equal. Today a test run observes 8 flu positives out of the first 10 samples from the waiting room.
items.question: Should the estimate of today's flu cases be revised upward from the original guess?
options: Yes, based on the newly observed sample
No, keep the original guess exactly
Only because flu is more typical in general
Not enough information because no one is sick
items.why_this_case_matters: SYNTHETIC near-miss for the primary confusion. A specific sample was observed and must move the estimate, so the core operation is updating on observed data, which belongs to the quantity-update-after-observation skill, not base-rate typicality. Distractor C wrongly invokes general typicality (this unit) when fresh data is the real driver.

items.scene: SYNTHETIC. A school newsletter says, 'Most students turned in the form on time.'
items.question: What does 'most' mean here?
items.why_this_case_matters: SYNTHETIC near-miss for the vague-quantity neighbor. The task is decoding the quantifier word 'most' into an approximate range, not comparing category likelihoods, so it routes to the vague-quantity interpretation skill.
